# HelloLocal

> HelloLocal maps local places, makers, services, and events for towns, regions, and tourism offices — including spots that are not on the main street.

## Product

- [Platform overview (HU)](https://hellolocal.hu/hu): Marketing landing and how HelloLocal works
- [Platform overview (EN)](https://hellolocal.hu/en): English overview
- [Pricing (HU)](https://hellolocal.hu/hu/tarife): Plans for municipalities and tourism offices
- [Sitemap](https://hellolocal.hu/sitemap.xml): Public crawl index

## For visitors

- [Live map demo](https://hellolocal.hu/hu): Open the visitor map experience from the language root
- [Privacy](https://hellolocal.hu/hu/adatvedelem): Privacy policy
